source.hardware: 20 DJI Tello drones, 4 environments incl. office, 12+ hours
source.notes: ESP32 carrier boards (device ids 20-21) excluded; sensor sheet only. No ground-truth position or RC logs, so only the sensor stream is calibrated.

packet_loss.shape: single-packet gaps (~0.2 s), no long bursts
packet_loss.caveat: measured with 20 drones sharing one router; a single drone is likely cleaner

attitude_deg.note: integer-degree output does not flicker when truly still; quantization dominates noise

velocity.evidence: values are pure integers, |v| never exceeds 40 units (= 4 m/s) in flight; regressing vgz against d(h)/dt gives ~14 cm/s per unit; SDK 3.0 guide states dm/s
velocity.sign_convention: vgz positive when descending (regression slope is negative vs climb rate)

acceleration_milli_g.note: quiet windows are propellers-off; in-flight vibration justifies a larger sim noise value

tof.note: not measurable from static ground data: reads a constant 10 cm below its minimum range, with out-of-range spikes of 6553
tof.sim_value_source: team estimate pending in-flight lab logs

OFFICE_TELEM_DROP_PROB.basis: measured 3.3% single-packet gaps; iid drops already produce that gap shape

OFFICE_TELEM_ATTITUDE_NOISE_DEG.basis: quantization dominates; 1 deg covers mild disturbance

_VEL_Q.basis: SDK reports integer dm/s, confirmed empirically

OFFICE_TELEM_TOF_NOISE_M.basis: team estimate; not measurable from this dataset

OFFICE_TELEM_BARO_WALK_M.basis: prior walk drifted faster than observed medium-term drift

OFFICE_TELEM_ACCEL_BIAS.basis: measured static bias up to ~19 milli-g = 0.19 m/s^2

OFFICE_TELEM_ACCEL_NOISE.basis: quiet floor is 0.01-0.06 m/s^2 propellers-off; margin for in-flight vibration

acceleration_semantics.basis: now raw specific force in the SDK z-down body frame: hover reads -9.8 m/s^2, matching static agz = -999 milli-g

velocity_vertical_sign.basis: flipped to SDK convention: positive = descending

still_needs_lab_logs: in-flight ToF noise and failure behavior
horizontal velocity sign conventions (vgx/vgy) vs stick directions
